form:FormGroup.label: Date and Time Format
form:FormGroup.helpText: The format used to show dates and times. Default is yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXX unless an administrator has changed the defaults.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Choose a format, or tick Custom to enter your own.

form:FormGroup.label: Custom Format
form:FormGroup.helpText: A Java DateTimeFormatter pattern, e.g. dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss. Only editable when Custom is ticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Java date pattern, e.g. dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss. Editable when Custom is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Time Zone
form:FormGroup.helpText: The time zone used to show dates and times: Local (your browser's time zone), UTC, Id (a named zone) or Offset (hours from UTC). Default is UTC unless an administrator has changed the defaults.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Local, UTC, Id or Offset. Default is UTC.

form:FormGroup.label: Time Zone Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: A named time zone, e.g. Europe/London. Only shown when Time Zone is Id.

form:FormGroup.label: Time Zone Offset
form:FormGroup.helpText: The number of hours ahead of or behind UTC, from -12 to +12. Only shown when Time Zone is Offset.
